title: Wire batch export and import into the CLI
description: Integrate the completed batch services into the public CLI. Add root command group wtp batch with export and import subcommands. Implement exact usage: wtp batch export --out PATH|- [--format csv|json] [--status STATUS | --task ID ...] and wtp batch import --in PATH|- [--format csv|json]. Require --out/--in explicitly; support repeatable --task; reject status-plus-task and malformed/extra arguments. Preserve root wtp export and legacy --export-tasks unchanged. For file export, human output reports destination/format/task count and root --json returns structured metadata. For --out -, write only raw batch bytes and reject root --json so stdout cannot mix data and summaries. Import human output prints updated/unchanged counts; root --json returns {"updated":[TaskView...],"unchanged":[TaskView...]} in input order. Route errors through existing CLI conventions with actionable row/field context. Update CLI provider doubles only as needed and add focused flag/parser/output tests, but leave process-level round trips to the integration task. Do not update README, skills, changelog, help prose, or schema prose beyond minimal command compilation. Finish with go test ./internal/cli and go test ./....
